minimum_integration.decision: Ordinary raw2 date grouping can now be integrated for an explicitly selected synthetic task set with separate sortDate and updatedAt fields, preserving existing known identity/pinned state. Enable only the closed ordinary grouping path. Priority mode remains out of scope.
algorithm: Obtain selected eligible tasks using separately documented selection/filter logic.
Sort items by raw sortDate using Foundation KeyPathComparator(.reverse).
Preserve official existing pinned/custom handling where already established. A fixture may explicitly provide these sets and label their provenance.
For each retained ordinary item in that order, select bucketDate by item case.
Compute day delta using Calendar.autoupdatingCurrent day starts and provider current date.
Return localized previous-seven-days for2...7, previous-thirty-days for8...30, month-wide and year if different for>=31, otherwise use relative formatter path.
Use the localized returned title as section identity. Create unseen sections at tail, append items to existing sections.
Keep this section order. Raw2 has no byWorkspaces rank or Projects superheader insertion.
minimum_integration.example_hazard: A thread with sortDate=distantFuture and old updatedAt sorts first but belongs to an older date bucket. That older bucket can precede Today; calendar-sorting buckets would change observed static behavior.
